rationale: B is more useful because it gives a clearer decision rule under different real-world conditions: default to shareability + customization, but swap in load time if performance is weak, or partnerships if a partner is already confirmed. That conditional structure better handles uncertainty and helps a careful decision-maker adapt to context. A is solid and more concrete on why load time matters, including one useful quantitative claim, but it is more rigid and less discriminative about when alternatives should win. B better separates controllable viral-loop features from external-risk partnership bets and offers stronger scenario-based guidance.
